critique.evidence: Positive measured evidence: no reported automated violations, keyboard traversal reaches live-wire and all other sections, no touch-target violations, no page-level horizontal overflow at 1440/768/390 px, the skip-link target measures 158×46 px, and reduced motion leaves the hero static. However, required checks remain unresolved at every viewport: 6 serious aria-prohibited-attr nodes, 2 critical duplicate-id-aria nodes, and 553/508/484 serious color-contrast nodes on desktop/tablet/mobile. Incomplete findings are not passes, and focus visibility was not demonstrated.
critique.fix: Resolve every incomplete audit item: give all ARIA/label references unique IDs, remove prohibited ARIA attributes or use valid roles/elements, and raise text/control contrast to WCAG thresholds—especially the small muted metadata visible throughout this screen. Then rerun axe until these checks pass and provide manual keyboard evidence showing a clearly visible focus indicator through the replay rows, controls, and trace panel at all three viewports.
